patterns.question_text:
Using the stockholders' equity balances as of December 31, Year 1, and the transactions and other information relating to Quonset's stockholders' equity during Year 2, complete the following worksheet analysis of stockholders' equity for Year 2. Ignore the effect of income taxes.

Enter increases to stockholders' equity as positive numbers and decreases as negative numbers. If there is no amount to enter in a particular cell, leave the cell blank.

exhibits.label: Information
exhibits.what_to_extract: Share count flow / transaction amounts by type
exhibits.read_tip: Read transactions in date order. Extract share counts first before dollar amounts.

items.en: Common stock: $1 par value; 1,650,000 shares authorized; 850,000 shares issued and outstanding — $850,000 / Additional paid-in capital — $3,100,000 / Retained earnings — $3,700,000
Feb 1 — Issued 13,000 shares to Carson Co. in exchange for land. Market price $13/share. Land carrying value $140,000; assessed value $95,000.
items.ko: 시가 $13 기준. CS=13K×$1=$13K / APIC=$156K. 장부가·assessed value 무시

items.en: Mar 5 — Purchased 21,000 shares at $12/share. Originally issued at $13. Cost method.
Jun 5 — Declared a property dividend of inventory. Carrying value $65,000; fair market value $55,000.
items.ko: E = –$55K (FMV 기준). 손실 $10K은 NI에 포함 → 중복 입력 금지

items.en: Jul 1 — Declared and issued a 15% stock dividend. No market price provided at declaration date.
items.ko: 기준주식수: 850K+13K–21K=842K × 15% = 126,300주. 시가 없음 → par 기준. C=+$126K / E=–$126K / APIC 변동 없음

items.en: Dec 5 — Declared cash dividend of $1 per share to stockholders of record on December 15, Year 2. Paid January 5, Year 3.

items.row: Unrealized gain on AFS debt securities
items.en: At December 31, Year 2 — unrealized holding gain on AFS debt securities: $95,000 net of tax.

solve_steps.detail: issuance → treasury → stock div → cash div 순서. 틀리면 이후 계산 전부 틀림

solve_steps.en: Assign each transaction to correct columns
solve_steps.ko: 거래 유형별 컬럼 배분 — market value / FMV / par / cost method 기준 적용

solve_steps.en: Record net income and AFS unrealized gain/loss
solve_steps.ko: NI → E(RE) 증가 / AFS unrealized → F(AOCI)만

solve_steps.en: Verify ending balances via H column total

rules.tx_type: Issuance of shares for noncash consideration
rules.en_rule: Record at market value of shares issued. CS = shares × par. APIC = remainder.
rules.ko_trap: 장부가·assessed value 사용 금지. 시가 우선

rules.en_rule: TS = –(shares × acquisition cost). No adjustment to CS, APIC, or RE.
rules.ko_trap: 원래 발행가와 차이를 APIC 조정하면 오답

rules.en_rule: RE = –FMV at declaration date. BV–FMV loss is included in net income.
rules.ko_trap: BV로 RE 차감하면 오답. 손실을 RE에 중복 입력 금지

rules.en_rule: RE = –(shares × par). CS = +(shares × par). APIC unchanged.
RE = –(shares × market price). CS = +(shares × par). APIC = remainder.
RE = –(shares outstanding at record date × $ per share). Based on declaration date.
rules.ko_trap: stock div 이후 누적 주식수 반드시 반영. 지급일 기준 아님

rules.en_rule: Record in AOCI (col F) only. No effect on RE.
rules.ko_trap: RE에 넣으면 즉시 오답 — OCI 항목

traps: Property dividend — use FMV ($55K), not BV ($65K) for RE reduction
Stock dividend with no market price — APIC does NOT change
Cash dividend share count — must include shares from stock dividend (968,300 not 842,000)
AFS unrealized gain — goes to AOCI (col F), never to RE

patterns.pattern_name: Treasury Stock: Par Value Method vs Cost Method
patterns.question_text:
Lexin Corp. uses the par value method to account for its treasury stock transactions. The company is considering changing to the cost method, and would like to evaluate the differences between the two methods and the impact that the change would have on the equity section of the company's balance sheet.

The following transactions occurred during the year:
- At the beginning of the year, 25,000 shares of $5 par common stock were issued at $8 per share.
- Several months later, Lexin repurchased 1,500 shares at $12 per share.
- Before the end of the fiscal year, the company re-sold 500 shares at $10 per share and then another 500 shares at $15 per share.

Part 1: Provide journal entries under the par value method (separate entries for each re-sell).
Part 2: Provide journal entries under the cost method (separate entries for each re-sell).
Part 3: Fill in the equity section comparison table under both methods.

exhibits.label: Transaction Data
exhibits.role: 분개 작성에 필요한 거래 조건 제공
exhibits.what_to_extract: 주식 수, par value, 발행가, 재매입가, 재매도가 2건
exhibits.read_tip: 4개 가격 구분이 핵심: par($5) / issuance($8) / buyback($12) / resell($10, $15)

items.en: 25,000 shares of $5 par common stock issued at $8 per share
Re-sold another 500 shares at $15 per share

solve_steps.en: Par Buy Back — decompose into original issuance components
Cost Buy Back — full cost in one line
Par Re-sell ① @$10 — no gain/loss concept
solve_steps.ko: Cash / T/S(par) / APIC–C/S(plug) — 손실이어도 RE 안 건드림

solve_steps.en: Cost Re-sell ① @$10 — loss: APIC–T/S first, then RE
solve_steps.ko: T/S release 원가기준 / 부족분 RE plug

solve_steps.en: Par Re-sell ② @$15 — same structure, APIC–C/S plug

solve_steps.ko: 초과분 APIC–T/S 쌓기 / RE 증가 불가

solve_steps.en: Equity comparison — verify both totals equal $194,500
solve_steps.ko: 계정 배분만 다르고 Total 동일 검산
solve_steps.detail:
Par: CS125K / T/S(2.5K) / APIC–C/S 78K / RE(6K) = 194.5K
Cost: CS125K / T/S(6K) / APIC–C/S 75K / APIC–T/S 1.5K / RE(1K) = 194.5K

rules.ko_trap: 두 방법 동일 — 헷갈릴 필요 없음
APIC–C/S = 재매입가−par 아님! 원래 issuance spread × 주수
원가 전액 T/S — APIC/RE 절대 건드리지 않음

rules.en_rule: Cash / T/S(par×sh) / APIC–C/S(plug) — regardless of gain/loss
rules.ko_trap: 이익/손실 개념 없음 / APIC–T/S 계정 없음 / 손실이어도 RE 안 건드림
이익 → APIC–T/S 쌓기 / RE 증가 절대 불가
APIC–T/S 잔액 먼저 소진 → 부족분만 RE

traps: Par Buy Back: APIC–C/S = 재매입가−par 아님 → 원래 issuance spread($3) × 주수
Par Re-sell: 이익/손실 개념 없음 — 손실이어도 RE 건드리지 않음
Cost Re-sell 이익: APIC–T/S 쌓기 / RE 증가 절대 불가
Cost Re-sell 손실: APIC–T/S 잔액 먼저 → 부족분만 RE
Total Equity: 두 방법 항상 동일 $194,500

patterns.question_text: During Years 1 and 2, JLC Corp., a calendar year-end company, had several transactions related to raising capital. For each situation in the table below, enter the appropriate value as it relates to JLC's diluted earnings per share computation for the six months ended June 30, Year 2. Use the facts in the exhibit and assume no income taxes. Round all amounts to the nearest whole number, except for diluted earnings per share. Round diluted earnings per share to two decimal places.

exhibits.label: JLC Capital Transactions
exhibits.role: 자본 조달 거래에 사용된 JLC 증권 관련 정보 전체 제공 — EPS 계산 재료 전부 포함
exhibits.what_to_extract: 전환우선주 발행 조건(배당률, 전환비율) / 보통주 기초주식수 및 추가발행일 / 평균시가(함정) / 전환사채 조건(이율, 원금, 전환비율) / 분기별 순이익
exhibits.read_tip: 평균시가 $59는 이 문제에서 사용하지 않는 함정 정보 — 옵션/워런트 없으므로 무시

items.en: In the second quarter of Year 1, JLC issued 600,000 shares of convertible preferred stock for assets in a purchase transaction. The quarterly dividend on the convertible stock is $0.05 per share, payable at the end of each quarter. Each share is convertible into one share of common stock.
items.ko: Year 1 2분기 발행 → Year 2 전체 유통 중. 분기배당 $0.05 × 2분기 = $60,000 (Basic EPS 분자 차감). 전환비율 1:1 → 전환 가정 시 증분주식 600,000주 (Diluted 분모에만 사용)

items.en: Common shares outstanding at January 1, Year 2, were 3,300,000.
items.ko: WASO 기산점. 기간 전체(6/6) 가중치 적용

items.en: 300,000 shares of common stock were issued for cash on March 31, Year 2.
The average market price for common stock for the first six months of Year 2 was $59 per share.
items.ko: ★함정 — Treasury Stock Method(옵션/워런트)에 사용되는 숫자. 이 문제엔 옵션 없음 → 계산에 사용하지 않음

items.en: In the last quarter of Year 1, JLC issued 4% convertible debentures with a principal of $10,000,000, due in 20 years, at $1,000 (par). Interest is payable annually on November 1. Each $1,000 debenture is convertible into 20 shares of common stock.
items.ko: Year 1 4분기 발행 → Year 2 전체 유통. 이자절감 = $10,000,000 × 4% × 6/12 = $200,000 (Diluted 분자 가산). 전환주식수 = $10,000,000 ÷ $1,000 × 20주 = 200,000주 (Diluted 분모 가산). Debenture = 무담보채권, FAR에서는 Convertible bond와 동일하게 취급

items.en: JLC did not declare or pay any dividends on its common stock for Year 2.
items.ko: IAC = NI - PS배당만 차감. 보통주 배당 추가 차감 없음 확인용 문장
★함정 — 보고기간 = 상반기(6개월) → Q1+Q2만 사용. Q3, Q4는 사용하지 않음. H1 NI = $6,600,000

solve_steps.ko: Basic EPS 먼저 계산 — 희석성 테스트 기준값

solve_steps.en: Test dilutiveness of each convertible security
solve_steps.ko: 각 전환증권의 희석성 테스트 — 증분 EPS < Basic EPS $1.90이면 희석성 있음
Diluted 분자 = NI + 이자절감 (전환우선주 있으면 PS배당 상쇄되어 NI 그대로 출발)
solve_steps.detail: $6,600,000 + $200,000 = $6,800,000. PS배당은 Basic에서 뺐다가 Diluted에서 다시 더해지므로 NI 그대로 사용

solve_steps.ko: 실제 유통 CS만 포함 — 전환우선주/전환사채는 여기 넣지 않음
전환 가정 시 추가되는 주식수 — Row 3과 별도로 쌓음

rules.en_rule: If converted: add back PS dividends to numerator + add converted shares to denominator
rules.ko_trap: Basic EPS에서 뺐던 PS배당을 Diluted에서 다시 더해야 함. 전환우선주가 있으면 NI 그대로 출발하면 자동 상쇄

rules.en_rule: If converted: add after-tax interest savings to numerator + add converted shares to denominator
rules.ko_trap: 이자 = 연간이율 × 원금 × 보고기간/12. 세율 없으면 전액 더함. Debenture = 무담보채권, Bond와 동일 취급

rules.en_rule: Weight = months outstanding / total reporting period length
rules.ko_trap: 분모 = 보고기간 총 길이. 연간=12, 반기=6, 분기=3. 연간 문제 습관으로 반기 문제에서 /12 쓰면 틀림

traps: 평균시가 $59 — 옵션/워런트 없으면 사용하지 않는 함정 정보
Q3, Q4 순이익 — 보고기간 상반기(6개월)이므로 Q1+Q2만 사용
전환사채 이자 연간($400,000) 그대로 쓰면 틀림 — 반기이므로 × 1/2 = $200,000
전환우선주/전환사채를 WASO(Row 3)에 포함하면 틀림 — Row 5,6에 별도 기재
희석성 테스트 생략 — 증분 EPS > Basic EPS면 anti-dilutive → 제외

rows.label: Income available to stockholders plus assumed conversions
Total adjusted weighted-average shares after dilution
